en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The vessels of gold and silver are belongings of those who have no conviction’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, Musa, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Utensils of gold and silver are of the assets of those who do not have certainty (in the laws of Allah).”’
